title: Injectivity of the Captured Word
statement: Let $M$ be a finite deterministic machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. For Boolean words $u$ and $v$, if the corresponding guessing-phase configurations built from $c$ and $u$, and from $c$ and $v$, are equal, then $u=v$.
hypotheses_covered: Equality of the two corresponding guessing-phase configurations
replaced: Let $M$ be a deterministic machine, $d$ one of its configurations, and $u, v$ captured words. If the guessing-phase invariant configurations for $(d,u)$ and $(d,v)$ are equal, then $u = v$.
